record.question: The immediate provocation for the quadruple alliance formed by Hyder Ali leading to the Second Anglo – Mysore war (1780-84) was:
options: The terms of the treaty of 1769 were not fulfilled by the Madras Government
When the Marathas invaded Hyder's territories in 1771, the English did not help
The English tried to play one South Indian power against another in order to prevent them from uniting
The English captured Mahe, the source of Hyder's military supplies
record.explanation: Hyder Ali’s alliance followed the English capture of Mahe.
